title: J2 static O-ring material + compression envelope
environment_facts: MARV containment may contain toxic, hot and potentially explosive sample gas
product scope includes wet metallurgical and potentially petrochemical service
exact universal list/concentration of media at J2 is not fully bounded in current documentation

seal_baseline.quality: ISO 3601-1 class B dimensional quality or supplier equivalent
seal_baseline.production_candidate: post-cured low-outgassing FKM, nominal 75 Shore A
seal_baseline.reason: current K01 evidence already uses FKM as the low-permeability baseline; current BOF release must also satisfy cost and supply-chain criteria
seal_baseline.fallback: FFKM 75A when the bounded media/temperature envelope cannot be approved for FKM
seal_baseline.exact_compound: OPEN — supplier compound, cure system, temperature/chemical compatibility and CoC required

tolerance_stack.interpretation: Tighter machining tolerances keep worst-case gland fill within ≈61–85% while retaining a bounded squeeze range.

compression_force_acceptance.method: supplier calculator/data for exact compound plus platen compression qualification to the released gland gap across temperature envelope
compression_force_acceptance.reason: total compression force is compound/hardness/temperature-dependent and must not be invented from geometry alone

release_tests: supplier compound compatibility statement/CoC for that envelope
compression force ≤300 N total at the worst qualified temperature in the released gland
leak test acceptance defined and passed
sources: MARV protection concept / user manual / EIC application

environment_control.critical_hold: J2-local temperature and complete released media envelope are not yet bounded by the current documents
environment_control.rule: No elastomer release from generic family name alone.
